environment.description: Deployed on an EC2 instance (t3.medium) in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding traffic on port 443 to target group on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB has no WAF WebACL associated. The Flask app runs under supervisord with FLASK_DEBUG=0. The SQLite database is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/data/. No request filtering or input validation middleware is configured at any layer.
